basic_details.job_title: NAM Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online for 9 DEO, Nursing Assistant and More Posts
basic_details.short_information: Nine contract posts in AYUSH institutions across Kottayam District are open, with a monthly consolidated remuneration of Rs. 10,500 to Rs. 15,000 depending on the post. The District Programme Management & Supporting Unit of National AYUSH Mission, Kottayam District, under advertisement No. NAM/EST/DPMSU/KTM/115/2026 dated 20 November 2026, invites applications for Ayurveda Nurse, Therapist (Male & Female), Attender, Data Entry Operator, Nursing Assistant, Multipurpose Worker (Drishti Project), Multipurpose Worker (Harsham Project), Multipurpose Health Worker and Yoga Instructor. Qualifications

age_limit.details: The age is counted as on 20 November 2026. | Post Age Limit Ayurveda Nurse, Therapist (Male & Female), Attender, Data Entry Operator, Nursing Assistant, Multipurpose Worker (Drishti Project), Multipurpose Worker (Harsham Project), Multipurpose Health Worker Not exceeding 40 years (as on 20-11-2026) Yoga Instructor Not exceeding 50 years (as on 20-11-2026) | The notice does not mention any age relaxation or minimum age.

qualification.details: Post Essential Qualification Ayurveda Nurse One Year certificate in Ayurveda Nursing approved by Govt. of Kerala Therapist (Male & Female) Ayurveda Therapist Course conducted by Govt. of Kerala/DAME/Ayurveda Panchakarma Technician Course with one year duration conducted by CCRAS Cheruthuruthy Attender SSLC pass Data Entry Operator Any Graduation & Govt. approved DCA/PGDCA course Nursing Assistant ANM or equivalent Multipurpose Worker (Drishti Project) 10th Pass Multipurpose Worker (Harsham Project) Plus 2 with DCA or above Multipurpose Health Worker B.Sc. Nursing/ GNM Nursing Approved by a recognized Nursing School with Kerala Nursing & midwife Council Registration Yoga Instructor Any one of the yoga qualifications listed below

how_to_apply: The notice asks for online applications only. It gives these instructions:
Check that you meet the eligibility criteria of the post you are applying for.
Submit the application form online at https://careers.nam.kerala.gov.in.
Clearly mention all details while filling the application; incomplete applications will be summarily rejected.
Complete the online submission by 5 December 2026.
The notice does not list the documents to upload. It does say that original documents will be produced at the time of Interview, and the details given in the online form must match them.
important_instructions: All nine posts are filled on contract basis, and the vacancies are shown as anticipatory. Selected candidates will work under various AYUSH institutions in Kottayam District. Incomplete applications will be summarily rejected. A mismatch between the application form and the original documents produced at the Interview leads to rejection of the candidature. Multipurpose Health Worker candidates need Kerala Nursing & Midwife Council Registration along with B.Sc. Nursing or GNM Nursing. Contact details printed on the notice: email [email protected], phone 0481 – 2991918; office at Inside District Ayurveda Hospital, Palace Road, Vayaskara, Kottayam, 686001.

content_sections.heading: About NAM Kottayam
content_sections.text: The recruitment is conducted by the District Programme Management & Supporting Unit of National AYUSH Mission (NAM), Kottayam District, Kerala. The unit's office is inside the District Ayurveda Hospital, Palace Road, Vayaskara, Kottayam, 686001, and the notice is signed by Dr. Jewel Jose, District Programme Manager, National AYUSH Mission, Kottayam. The selected candidates will work under various AYUSH institutions in Kottayam District; two Multipurpose Worker posts are attached to the Drishti Project and the Harsham Project.

content_sections.heading: Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: The notice lists nine posts. For every post the vacancy column says "Anticipatory", so no fixed number of posts is printed. The remuneration is a monthly consolidated amount. The notice does not mention HRA or any other allowance on top of it.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: The notice accepts any one of the following for the Yoga Instructor post: BNYS (Bachelor of Naturopathy and Yogic Sciences) BAMS MSc (Yoga) MPhil (Yoga) Post Graduate Diploma in Yoga (Minimum one year duration) from a recognized University Approved Certificate Course in Yoga (one year duration) from a recognized University or Government Department YCB (Yoga Certification Board) Certificate Yoga Teacher Training Course of at least one year's duration from the State Resource Centre (SRC) Diploma in Yogic Science & Sports Yoga conducted by SCOLE Kerala Certificate Course in Yoga (one year duration) The notice prints no experience requirement or desirable qualification for any post. The Therapist post is open to both male and female candidates. Candidates should check the official notification for the exact eligibility wording of each post. The age is counted as on 20 November 2026. The notice does not mention any age relaxation or minimum age.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for NAM Kottayam Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: The notice asks for online applications only. It gives these instructions: Check that you meet the eligibility criteria of the post you are applying for. Submit the application form online at https://careers.nam.kerala.gov.in . Clearly mention all details while filling the application; incomplete applications will be summarily rejected. Complete the online submission by 5 December 2026. The notice does not list the documents to upload. It does say that original documents will be produced at the time of Interview, and the details given in the online form must match them.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: According to the notice, the selection procedure includes a Skill Test/Written Test and Interview, "as the case may be". The notice does not say which posts will have a skill test or a written test, and it does not give a date or venue for any test or interview. At the Interview, candidates produce their original documents. If the particulars furnished in the application form do not tally with these original documents, the candidature will be rejected.

faq.question: Q1. How many posts are covered in NAM Kottayam Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The notice covers nine posts, from Ayurveda Nurse to Yoga Instructor. The vacancies for every post are shown as "Anticipatory".

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for NAM Kottayam Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date for submission of online applications is 5 December 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What qualification is needed for NAM Kottayam Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: It depends on the post: 10th Pass for Multipurpose Worker (Drishti Project), SSLC pass for Attender, Plus 2 with DCA or above for Multipurpose Worker (Harsham Project), ANM or equivalent for Nursing Assistant, and Any Graduation & Govt. approved DCA/PGDCA course for Data Entry Operator. Nursing, therapy and yoga posts need the specific courses listed in the notice.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for NAM Kottayam Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The age must not exceed 40 years as on 20 November 2026 for eight posts, and must not exceed 50 years as on 20 November 2026 for the Yoga Instructor post.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary for NAM Kottayam posts?
faq.answer: The monthly consolidated remuneration is Rs. 15,000 for Multipurpose Health Worker, Rs. 14,700 for Ayurveda Nurse and Therapist, Rs. 14,175 for Data Entry Operator, Rs. 14,000 for Yoga Instructor, Rs. 11,550 for Nursing Assistant and Rs. 10,500 for Attender and both Multipurpose Worker posts.

faq.question: Q6. How do I apply for NAM Kottayam Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Submit the application form online at https://careers.nam.kerala.gov.in by 5 December 2026, filling in all details clearly, as incomplete applications will be summarily rejected.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for NAM Kottayam Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The selection procedure includes a Skill Test/Written Test and Interview, as the case may be.

faq.question: Q8. Are the NAM Kottayam posts permanent?
faq.answer: No. The notice states that the posts are filled on contract basis, with a monthly consolidated remuneration.

faq.question: Q9. Can both men and women apply for the Therapist post?
faq.answer: Yes. The post is advertised as Therapist (Male & Female).

faq.question: Q10. Which registration is needed for the Multipurpose Health Worker post?
faq.answer: Candidates need B.Sc. Nursing or GNM Nursing approved by a recognized Nursing School with Kerala Nursing & Midwife Council Registration.
